# @carbide/cli — public API surface

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-surface.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

The `carbide` binary. Its stable contract is the command/flag surface, the exit-code taxonomy, and the structured error categories — not the module graph behind them.

Frozen at version `0.1.0`.

## `carbide — exit codes and error categories`

```ts
export interface ClassifiedError {
    exitCode: CliExitCode;
    category: CliErrorCategory;
    code: string;
    message: string;
    details?: Record<string, unknown>;
    stack?: string;
}

export type CliErrorCategory = "internal" | "schema-mismatch" | "flag-error" | "lock-read" | "allow-list-refusal" | "safety-refusal" | "offline-cache-miss" | "nuget-fetch-failed" | "project-graph-cycle" | "assembly-name-collision" | "project-reference-missing";

export type CliExitCode = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

export interface HandleCliFailureOptions {
    verbose?: boolean;
}

export declare function classifyError(err: unknown): ClassifiedError;

export declare function handleCliFailure(err: unknown, format: Format, options?: HandleCliFailureOptions): CliExitCode;
```
